subject: How to test that a shiny app is deployed using testthat?

messages.author: ff4a8f4fdb7301a0
messages.subject: How to test that a shiny app is deployed using testthat?
parts:
Hi,

How would you test that a shiny app is deployed? I thought of using Rcurl::url.exists() which works if the app is runnin, but not if it's sleeping. For example:

> library(testthat)
>         expect_equal(
+             RCurl::url.exists('https://jhubiostatistics.shinyapps.io/recount/'),
+             TRUE
+         )
Error: RCurl::url.exists("https://jhubiostatistics.shinyapps.io/recount/") not equal to TRUE.
1 element mismatch
> options(width = 120)
> devtools::session_info()

Interactively, I can force the app to be running by using utils::browseURL() first, but that won't work when testing in a non-interactive environment. Such as with:

if(interactive()) {
    ## Open shiny app when running test in interactive mode.
    ## This will force the app to be available, which will then run the test
    ## successfully.
    browseURL('https://jhubiostatistics.shinyapps.io/recount/')
    test_that('Shiny app is up', {
        expect_equal(
            RCurl::url.exists('https://jhubiostatistics.shinyapps.io/recount/'),
            TRUE
        )
    })
}


Thank you!
Leo

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to test that a shiny app is deployed using testthat?
parts: Yes, unfortunately you would need to use a tool like phantomjs to hit your application and start it up.  Recall that applications are put to sleep when they aren't receiving traffic, unless you specifically tune them to stay up for a longer period of time.
